name: Worker Placement
description: Players take turns placing their worker tokens (meeples) on available action spaces on a common game board. Placing a worker typically triggers an action associated with that space. Action spaces are often limited, creating competition.

parameters.name: Number of Workers
parameters.description: How many workers each player controls.

parameters.name: Action Space Exclusivity
parameters.description: Can multiple workers occupy the same action space?

examples_in_games.specific_implementation_notes: One of the earliest prominent examples, with a moving provost affecting action resolution.
Features a growing number of action spaces throughout the game.

notes_on_combination_modification: Often combined with resource conversion or set collection. Can be modified by adding special worker abilities or dynamic action spaces.
